content.title: Breakdown of Luka Doncic highest scoring games
content.text: Luka Doncic set his career high with a 73-point performance against the Atlanta Hawks on January 26, 2024. This achievement tied the Dallas Mavericks star for the fourth-most points scored in a single NBA game. Previously, Doncic's highest scoring game was against the New York Knicks on December 27, 2022, when he scored 60 points. Luka Doncic's scoring feats have become legendary, with several games showcasing his ability to dominate offensively while maintaining efficiency. On January 26, 2024, the Dallas Mavericks superstar delivered the performance of his career, scoring 73 points against the Atlanta Hawks. This achievement tied him for the fourth-most points in a single NBA game, further solidifying his status as one of the league's premier scorers. The stat line for this game –25-of-33 shooting, 8-of-13 from three-point range, and 15-of-16 from the free-throw line – epitomized his scoring versatility and efficiency. This 73-point performance surpassed his previous career-high of 60 points, set on December 27, 2022, in an overtime win against the New York Knicks. In that game, Luka not only scored but also facilitated, becoming the first player in NBA history to record a 60-point, 20-rebound triple-double. That night encapsulated Luka's ability to dominate in multiple facets of the game, blending scoring with playmaking to lead his team to victory. It would have been symbolic for him to score 77, as this is the unusual number Doncic has worn throughout his career. Perhaps he'll do it at some point. Other standout games include his two 51-point performances, one against the San Antonio Spurs in December 2022 and another against the Los Angeles Clippers in February 2022. These games highlight his capacity to rise to the occasion against various opponents and in high-pressure scenarios. His 50-point games against the Houston Rockets and Phoenix Suns in late 2023 further showed his consistency as an elite scorer. Luka's scoring brilliance in these games came with remarkable shot-making, whether from deep three-pointers or through crafty finishes around the rim.
